reasons: Compliant claim is supported by the cited text: § 2(a) grants a non-exclusive licence and affirmatively confirms Client is not obligated to use it and may acquire, develop or licence competing software/services, so no sole-supplier or requirements covenant binds the Customer.
The only exclusivity-flavoured grant runs in our favour (Client grants TrueLink a non-exclusive licence in Credit Data), which the rule expressly treats as acceptable.

§ 3(i)'s obligation to order a TrueLink credit report is channel-tied to underwriting requests made through the Interface (which Client is free not to use) and is properly noted in the rationale as a sub-element rather than flagged as a deviation, consistent with the playbook's classification semantics.

Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline or counterparty comment was proposed and the rendered text is unchanged; the deterministic check (no requirements/sole-supplier obligation remaining) also passes.
